data record(application="*") | append [
fetch spans, scanLimitGBytes:100, samplingRatio:1000
| summarize item=collectDistinct( dt.security_context)
| expand item | sort item
]

data record(application="*") | append [

fetch spans, scanLimitGBytes:100, samplingRatio:1000
| filter if($security_context == "*", true, else: dt.security_context == $security_context)
| filter if($host_group == "*", true, else: dt.host_group.id == $host_group)
| filter if($k8s_namespace == "*", true, else: k8s.namespace.name == $k8s_namespace)
//| filter if($process_group == "*", true, else: dt.entity.process_group in [ fetch dt.entity.process_group | filter entity.name == $process_group | fields id ] )

| summarize dt.entity.process_group=collectDistinct(dt.entity.process_group)
| expand dt.entity.process_group
| fieldsAdd name=entityName(dt.entity.process_group)
| fields name
| sort name

/*
fetch dt.entity.process_group
| fields entity.name
| sort entity.name
*/
]

// do a 10 minute query with fixed sampling ratio of 100
// see how many spans come in return and try to figure out optimal samplingRatio for whole dashboard
// the desired samplingRatio should result in ~150k spans queried for whole timeframe

fetch spans
, from: -10m, to: now()
, scanLimitGBytes:-1
, samplingRatio:100

// apply dashboard filter here
// dashboard filters
| filter if($security_context == "*", true, else: dt.security_context == $security_context)
| filter if($host_group == "*", true, else: dt.host_group.id == $host_group)
| filter if($k8s_namespace == "*", true, else: k8s.namespace.name == $k8s_namespace)
| filter if($process_group == "*", true, else: dt.entity.process_group in [ fetch dt.entity.process_group | filter entity.name == $process_group | fields id ] )
 
| summarize spansPerMinute=count()/10*100

| fieldsAdd dashboardTimeframe=toTimestamp($dt_timeframe_to)-toTimestamp($dt_timeframe_from)
| fieldsAdd dashboardTimeframeMinutes = toDouble(dashboardTimeframe/1000/1000/1000/60)
| fieldsAdd spansInTimeframe=spansPerMinute*dashboardTimeframeMinutes

| fieldsAdd desiredSpanVolume = 150*1000

| fieldsAdd desired_sampling_rate = bin(spansInTimeframe / desiredSpanVolume, 1)
| fieldsAdd desired_sampling_rate = if(desired_sampling_rate < 1, 1, else: desired_sampling_rate)

| fields desired_sampling_rate

0.title: Requests
0.query:
fetch spans, scanLimitGBytes:toLong($scan_limit_gb), samplingRatio:toLong($auto_sampling_ratio)

// dashboard filters
| filter if($security_context == "*", true, else: dt.security_context == $security_context)
| filter if($host_group == "*", true, else: dt.host_group.id == $host_group)
| filter if($k8s_namespace == "*", true, else: k8s.namespace.name == $k8s_namespace)
| filter if($process_group == "*", true, else: dt.entity.process_group in [ fetch dt.entity.process_group | filter entity.name == $process_group | fields id ] )

// calculate multiplicity factor for every span, to for extrapolations
| fieldsAdd sampling.probability = (power(2, 56) - coalesce(sampling.threshold, 0)) * power(2, -56)
| fieldsAdd sampling.multiplicity = 1/sampling.probability
| fieldsAdd multiplicity = coalesce(sampling.multiplicity, 1)
                         * coalesce(aggregation.count, 1)
                         * dt.system.sampling_ratio
| fieldsAdd multiplicity = if($extrapolate=="true", multiplicity, else: coalesce(aggregation.count, 1))

// requests only
| filter request.is_root_span == true

| fieldsAdd service = entityName(dt.entity.service)

| makeTimeseries count = sum(multiplicity), by:{ service }

| sort count desc
| limit 1000

24.title: Database - Most Frequent Queries
24.query:
fetch spans, scanLimitGBytes:toLong($scan_limit_gb), samplingRatio:toLong($auto_sampling_ratio)

// dashboard filters
| filter if($security_context == "*", true, else: dt.security_context == $security_context)
| filter if($host_group == "*", true, else: dt.host_group.id == $host_group)
| filter if($k8s_namespace == "*", true, else: k8s.namespace.name == $k8s_namespace)
| filter if($process_group == "*", true, else: dt.entity.process_group in [ fetch dt.entity.process_group | filter entity.name == $process_group | fields id ] )

// calculate multiplicity factor for every span, to for extrapolations
| fieldsAdd sampling.probability = (power(2, 56) - coalesce(sampling.threshold, 0)) * power(2, -56)
| fieldsAdd sampling.multiplicity = 1/sampling.probability
| fieldsAdd multiplicity = coalesce(sampling.multiplicity, 1)
                         * coalesce(aggregation.count, 1)
                         * dt.system.sampling_ratio
| fieldsAdd multiplicity = if($extrapolate=="true", multiplicity, else: coalesce(aggregation.count, 1))

// database spans only
| filter span.kind == "client"
| filter isNotNull(db.namespace) and isNotNull(db.query.text)

| fieldsAdd has_exception = iAny(span.events[][span_event.name] == "exception")

| summarize {Count = sum(multiplicity), 
             Latency = avg(duration),
             Errors = sum(if(span.status_code == "failed" or has_exception, multiplicity, else: 0))
             }, by:{Database = db.namespace, Query = db.query.text}

| fieldsAdd Errors = if(isNull(Errors), 0, else:Errors)
| sort Count desc
| limit 10

| filter request.is_failed == true

| fieldsAdd service = entityName(dt.entity.service)

| fieldsAdd ResponseCode = toLong(http.response.status_code)

| filter ResponseCode >= 500

| fieldsAdd exception = toString(span.events[][exception.message])

| summarize {Errors = sum(multiplicity),
             Latency = median(duration),
             ExceptionMessages = toString(collectDistinct(exception)),
             ResponseCodes = toString(collectDistinct(ResponseCode))
             }, 
             by: {Service = service, Request = endpoint.name}
| fields Service, Request, Errors, ResponseCodes, Latency, ExceptionMessages
| sort Errors desc
| limit 10

31.title: Top Exceptions
31.query:
fetch spans, scanLimitGBytes:toLong($scan_limit_gb), samplingRatio:toLong($auto_sampling_ratio)

// dashboard filters
| filter if($security_context == "*", true, else: dt.security_context == $security_context)
| filter if($host_group == "*", true, else: dt.host_group.id == $host_group)
| filter if($k8s_namespace == "*", true, else: k8s.namespace.name == $k8s_namespace)
| filter if($process_group == "*", true, else: dt.entity.process_group in [ fetch dt.entity.process_group | filter entity.name == $process_group | fields id ] )

// calculate multiplicity factor for every span, to for extrapolations
| fieldsAdd sampling.probability = (power(2, 56) - coalesce(sampling.threshold, 0)) * power(2, -56)
| fieldsAdd sampling.multiplicity = 1/sampling.probability
| fieldsAdd multiplicity = coalesce(sampling.multiplicity, 1)
                         * coalesce(aggregation.count, 1)
                         * dt.system.sampling_ratio
| fieldsAdd multiplicity = if($extrapolate=="true", multiplicity, else: coalesce(aggregation.count, 1))

| fieldsAdd Process = entityName(dt.entity.process_group_instance)
| fieldsAdd Service = entityName(dt.entity.service)

// only spans with exception
| filter iAny(span.events[][span_event.name] == "exception")

// make exception attributes top level attributes
| expand span.events | fieldsFlatten span.events | fieldsRemove span.events

| fieldsAdd exception.message = span.events.exception.message
| fieldsAdd exception.type = span.events.exception.type

| summarize Count = sum(multiplicity), by:{Service, Process, Type = exception.type, Message = exception.message}
| sort Count desc
| fields Service, Process, Type, Message, Count
| limit 10
